name: SendGrid
one_liner: Twilio SendGrid email platform: v3 REST API for transactional and marketing email, with event webhooks and SDKs.
auth_notes: API keys sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Keys are created in Settings > API Keys with full, custom, billing or email-validation permissions; max 100 keys per account. Billing APIs need a separate key.
access_notes: Free plan retired from May 27, 2025: sending paused on free plans after 60 days. New accounts get a free trial, no credit card; paid plans required afterwards (Essentials about $19.95/mo per third-party search summary).

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key and documented v3 REST API with OpenAPI spec, but the free plan is retired; only a time-limited trial exists and sustained sending requires a paid plan.

auth.quote: include an Authorization header with the value Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE> in your request
Twilio limits accounts to 100 API keys.

access.quote: Email sending will be paused for accounts on all free plans
Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required

api_surface.quote: If you exceed that limit, the API returns an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) status code.
To secure the Event Webhook data, use the Signed Event Webhook, OAuth 2.0, or both.
The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale
